hints.text: Follow the order of operations: the power is done FIRST, and only then do you multiply by the start value.
Work out the power: $2^3 = 2 \times 2 \times 2 = 8$. Then multiply that $8$ by the $4$ in front.
Multiplying gives $4 \times 8 = 32$, so the value of $y$ at $x = 3$ is $32$.

explanation: In the order of operations, powers come before multiplying, so handle $2^x$ first.
With $x = 3$, the power is three twos multiplied together: $2^3 = 2 \times 2 \times 2 = 8$.
Now multiply by the front number: $4 \times 8 = 32$, so $y = 32$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Take the steps one at a time
steps: Three steps of doubling land on $32$.
